title: Production-Ready E-commerce Interface
objective: Build and document a cohesive e-commerce frontend prototype. The capstone focuses on interface engineering, not a complete payment or backend system.

acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate responsive homepage with header, hero, categories and featured products in the project.
Keep the implementation responsive, semantic and maintainable.

required_features: Responsive homepage with header, hero, categories and featured products
Product listing, badges, filtering and product detail layout
Cart and checkout interface with accessible forms and validation presentation
Customer account, order history and status displays
Light/dark themes, reusable tokens, custom utilities and component variants
Responsive testing, production build, accessibility audit and visual-regression checklist
stretch_features: Add a documented theme variant or design token where appropriate.
Add a visual regression check for one representative state.
Document a trade-off or browser-support limitation.
tests: Build with the configured Vite/Tailwind workflow.
Inspect narrow, medium and wide viewport layouts.
Check keyboard navigation, focus indication, semantic roles and contrast.
Verify that required utility classes appear in generated CSS.
review_method: Static source checks plus human review; project code is not executed in the production FastAPI process.
status_note: Draft project outline; verify the implementation against the resolved dependencies before publication.
